Why Second Residency

Why Do You Need a Second Residency?

In an era of globalization, a second residency is not just a symbol of status — it is a safeguard for your assets and quality of life.

Global Mobility

Holding a South African PR grants visa-free or visa-on-arrival access, allowing you to freely enter South Africa and multiple African countries, expanding possibilities for both business and lifestyle.

Asset Protection

Through South Africa's robust financial system and legal framework, achieve global asset diversification, reduce single-market risk, and safeguard family wealth.

Tax Planning

South Africa's tax residency system offers flexible tax planning opportunities. Combined with a professional accounting team, we tailor an optimized tax solution for you.

Application Process

South Africa PR Application Process

Professional team guidance throughout — obtain permanent residency in 4 simple steps

STEP 01

Initial Assessment & Consultation

A Crestline Advisory professional consultant evaluates your eligibility, confirms your asset qualifications, and provides personalized application strategy recommendations.

STEP 02

Document Preparation & Notarization

We assist with preparing all application documents, including asset proof, police clearance, medical examination, and complete notarization through South African overseas missions.

STEP 03

Submission & Tracking

South African immigration attorneys submit the application to the Department of Home Affairs, with full tracking of the review process and real-time status updates to ensure a smooth process.

STEP 04

PR Approval & Post-Arrival Services

After successfully obtaining permanent residency, we provide post-arrival services including bank account setup, tax registration, and children's school enrollment for a seamless transition into South African life.

Asset Threshold
R 16,000,000
PR Asset Threshold

To apply for South African permanent residency (PR), you must demonstrate net assets of at least R 16,000,000. These assets may include real estate, deposits, stocks, and various other forms, with assessment assistance from the Crestline Advisory professional team.

* Actual thresholds are subject to the latest announcements from the South African Department of Home Affairs. Professional consultants will provide the most up-to-date information.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about South Africa PR applications

The general application process takes approximately 6 to 12 months. Actual time depends on the completeness of document preparation and the review progress of the South African Department of Home Affairs. The Crestline Advisory professional team will assist throughout to ensure a smooth process.

Yes, the net asset threshold of R 16,000,000 can include various forms, including real estate, bank deposits, stocks, and funds. Our professional consultants will assist you in organizing the asset proof documents to ensure compliance with application requirements.

South African PR holders must meet certain residency requirements, typically at least 3 months per year, or a cumulative 12 months every 3 years. Specific requirements may vary by individual circumstances, and we recommend consulting with a professional immigration attorney.

If your application is rejected, our immigration attorney team will analyze the reasons for the rejection, assist with supplementary documents, or file an appeal. Crestline Advisory has extensive experience with appeals, significantly improving success rates.

Yes, after holding South African PR for 5 years, meeting residency requirements and other conditions, you can apply for South African citizenship. Obtaining citizenship grants full political rights and a South African passport.
